task.title: M2: D3 treemap with complexity/churn color toggle and tier badges
task.description:
Build the treemap view, the first visualization: files nested by directory, area proportional to code lines, color switchable between complexity (max per file) and churn (commits in the window). Hovering shows path, loc/code/comments, complexity sum/max/functions, churn commits/authors. A per-language tier badge (precise or baseline) from snapshot.languages is shown in the view header. The treemap must handle a repo the size of Capacitor smoothly.

Acceptance criteria:
- Treemap renders from any valid Snapshot via the DataSource; directory nesting follows path segments and zooms on click.
- Color toggle switches between complexity and churn scales with a legend; scales are consistent across refs of the same repo.
- Tooltip shows the file metrics listed above; files with no churn data render in a neutral color.
- Tier badges render one chip per language in snapshot.languages.
- Renders Capacitor's snapshot with no dropped frames on interaction (measured in the PR), and a unit test covers the hierarchy builder.
